Presented file
Phase 5 is in positional-phase5.tar.gz. It contains only the changed and new files, laid out from the repo root. Extract it from the repo root with tar xzf positional-phase5.tar.gz. The last CI run on Phase 4 (2bae2c6d) passed.

What changed

Arts is now a Compose VerticalPager built on a tested ArtsCatalog. The current page is still saved, and the old ViewPager2 adapter and layouts are gone.
Help and legal pages:
A new HtmlPage enum replaces the old practice of passing localized title strings around.
Every caller now uses WebPageViewerActivity.open(context, page). The callers are Settings, the GPS menu, the trail menu, compass physical properties and custom locations.
The viewer is a Compose screen that hosts CustomWebView and keeps its scroll state when the screen rotates.
null.html, FastScrollWebView, HtmlViewer and OverScrollBehavior are removed.
Map search is now a Compose screen with a MapSearchViewModel.
Address lookup waits 800 ms after typing stops (debounce) and cancels any older lookup still running. It uses the non-blocking Geocoder API on Android 13 and newer, and a background thread below that.
The map’s lifecycle is now handled properly. The old screen never paused or destroyed it.
Coordinates update when the map stops moving rather than on every frame, which saves battery. Tapping the map moves it to that point.
The coordinates are checked before the result is returned.
The keyboard now resizes the screen (adjustResize).
Target address was never opened from anywhere, so the activity, fragment, adapter, view model, layouts and manifest entry are deleted.
Manifest: ArtsActivity is no longer exported.
Tests:
New HtmlPageTest checks that every page has an HTML file and every HTML file has a page.
New ArtsCatalogTest and MapSearchQueryTest.
CoordinateInputTest has a new formatting case.
README: Phase 5 is marked done and Phase 6 next.
I couldn’t compile this here because the sandbox can’t reach Google’s Maven repository. The CI run is the real check.
